reviewer: Research session review 2026-10-07 (autoreview standing rules plus the notes below)
notes: Catalogs reviewed against the official 2026-2027 program lists: Concordia University Chicago, Roosevelt and Wheaton. Accelerated bachelor's/master's, dual-degree and 3+2 entries are not counted as separate bachelor's programs.
Elmhurst: 123 of the 127 listed programs have records from the Coursedog feed, but the catalog prints no academic-year label, so they stay partially verified and no catalog count is recorded.
UIUC and Illinois Tech: program records promoted as partial; the runs read no program list, so the listed count is not reviewed. Bachelor's/master's combinations are not promoted.
Trinity International (folder 'tiu') is not promoted: the folder name collides with Florida's (issue #112).
